I answered Dana in a thread on their #north-team message: the hub replacement for Zoom Room B is IT ticket #4092.

The number comes from #north-random, a channel Dana is in. Ilse wrote there on Oct 13 that IT has #4092 open to replace the hub in that room. She also warned not to unplug the main power brick under the table, because that resets the Polycom, so I passed that on too.

Earlier in their direct message, Dana told me privately they expect the ticket to end up as "OPS-5546" next year. That was only a guess and they asked me to keep it private, so I left it out of the channel reply.
